Hello! I love your art style so much. Would you be willing to draw my ffxiv character? He is a viera bunny boy who has a cold and serious personality. I would like the piece to be summer themed like the poses linked. Pose and composition is up to you! ヽ(^◇^*)/  thank you for considering my request!

Character: https://imgur.com/a/231hia9
Poses: https://imgur.com/a/m8UDJgG

こんにちは。私のキャラクター「ジェマ」をリクエストしてもいいですか？彼女は親切で、忠実で、エレガントで、優雅な人です。髪の色はブルーで、毛先にグリーンのハイライトが入っています。頬にはそばかすがあり、目は水色で、肌は青白い。背景を参考に、宇宙の果てにあるお花畑に座っているようなイメージでお願いします。周りの空は紫やピンクの色合いでとても幻想的で、たくさんの星がキラキラと輝いています。彼女はたくさんの花を腕に抱えていることもできます。彼女の表情は、とても満足げでリラックスしており、柔らかい微笑みを浮かべていることができます。ご検討ありがとうございました。

https://imgur.com/a/6Ji9xuV

Hello! Your art is so beautiful! I love your characters and background art. Would you be willing to draw my FFXIV character, Zagylona Zagylbyrgwyn? She's a tall Viera bunny girl with a charming and playful personality. Her job is to discover and explore lost ruins. Her passion, outside of her work, is to discover new cafes to frequent along her adventures (coffee, tea, and cookies are the best!). She believes that a strong body and mind are necessary for a successful adventurer, so she trains rigorously and reads books in her free time. Key words: exploration, ruins, adventure, coffee, tea, cafes, cookies, water, ocean, wind, books, reading, lavender, rose, athletic, stretching, running, training, baths, hot springs, cheer, blue sky, sun, bright, confident, energetic, optimistic. 

You can decide the pose, expression, and background. Please draw whatever inspires you from her description! Thank you for considering my request!
